---
title: "Trap: a d2 error in a fenced block"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

d2 names the line of the copy mdbrand writes to the work directory, which
leads nowhere in the document: the error names the block by its caption.

```d2 caption="Flujo de altas"
alta -> validación
validación -> registro
}
```
